scripts.generate:provider: cd provider && dart run flax_codegen generate --config bindings/flax_bindings.yaml
scripts.generate:host: cd host && dart run flax_codegen generate --config bindings/flax_bindings.yaml
scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:provider && pnpm run generate:host
scripts.build:host: pnpm --filter @example/prices-runtime run build && pnpm --filter configured-host-js run build && pnpm --filter @example/host-modules run build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.pack:sdk: pnpm --dir provider/js-types pack && pnpm --dir host/js/sdk/types pack
